$i$I heard the plant is poisonous. We can retreat from here for now. Let's come back to deal with them when you're fully recovered. $n$Time isn't enough. Now that Sunset Legion appears without disguise. It's obvious that the evil Wind Spirit's power has fully restored. The consequence would be inconceivable if we let them go on like this.
$n$These steeds are equally fearless fighters. They are known as Dragon Horses. There's really no match for these beasts after so many ordeals of combat.

$i$Who are you? I heard you fought with the Dauntless Mercenary Group? $n$Are you one of them? $n$I went there to look. Now that we follow them here, we'll do some investigation. I won't let any clue slip.
$i$There is a weird dry well there. I can't approach it. $n$I also noticed that Rhino and Thunder Beast all seem to be protecting it. I wonder what's in there.
$n$I'm alright! I can't let them run wild because of me. $i$How about your wound?
$n$I know what to do. I won't use this unless I have to. We made it just in case.
$n$This scenario reminds me of the very moment I joined the Sunset Dragoons. The only difference is the general is no more.
$n$Thunder Hawkman is very aggressive, and furious with magic power. Thanks god you're not hurt.
$n$In the battlefield, the more abilities at your command, the more likelihood of your survival. That will certainly incline the tide of war in your favor.
$n$Now we have some trouble. The giant tornado of Windy Plateau is the most dangerous threat. Now our journey is even more perilous.

$n$Windy Plateau is very vast. Now that Wind Spirit is hidden here, it would be rather hard to spot him. $i$I hope to go to the Holy War Wilderness with you. $n$In the early days of the Sunset Dragoons, the veterans would teach these skills to the fresh recruits, who would in due time, pass them on to the next generation. This practice would quickly assimilate the new members to the group.
$n$For a long while, we were out of the attention of the world. However, no one ever dared to ignore our existence. I seem to be excited by war again.
$n$Excellent work! Now Sunset Legion is in great chaos. Now it is the perfect time to wipe them out.
$n$Just as expected, it's Psychical Curse. We'll have a tough journey.
$n$Because of the eliminating, the Sunset Dragoons are mostly feared by the public. If I recall correctly, the General once said we never denied that and we never craved any change of that.
$n$Looks like you've caused big trouble for them. I've sensed their internal chaos.
$n$We're all exhausted. This result is quite…unexpected.
$n$It can't go like this. There are too many Rhinos here. We can't fight these powerful and furious creatures.
$n$Thanks for you help. I didn't expect there are still people remembering general's merits and achievements.
$n$I was right. Wind Spirit has now become evil completely. He will not watch us eliminate Sunset Legion.

$n$Anyone daring to step in the way of the Sunset Dragoons will all be split apart. The order used to be an embodiment of pride. However, without the General's leadership nowadays, it is on the decline.
$n$So many Skeleton Mages here. Some Necromancer must have been here before.
$n$I found out what they were protecting. It's a weird space. There is no sign of Ghost Cavalry. Looks like we can only head for Holy War Wilderness to investigate.
$n$I believe their own smell won't make them angry.

$n$The masters of this school of spells are usually known as Necromancers. Their practice of the dark craft makes them easily distinctive by appearance.

$i$I found the Element Heart near the Tornado in Holy War Wilderness. Christ believes that someone has come here ahead of us. He hopes you can trace this person. This might be the only clue to find the General. $n$Deep inside the Holy War Wilderness? Not everyone is able to get there. We really need to investigate it.
$n$Now it's my turn. Hope we can make it this time.

$n$The dark magic is an evil school of the arts no one can turn a blind eye to. Mage Neo was a genius with magic running through his veins. He was an archmage adept at each school of spells. He was obsessed with magical study. It is he who created the dark magic.
$n$He must be crazy to use this method. I'm afraid he won't be able to control himself then.
$n$It's not working. I can't sense them at all. Will we lose a chance to find the general?
$n$Well, it's all over here. We're leaving for Holy War Wilderness to continue our investigation of that Ghost Cavalry.
$n$There is no materials available around. We can only use them for now. I just don’t know if there will be some bad reactions. But we don't have time to think about that.
$n$I'm afraid we can't leave for now. We're gonna have some trouble.
$n$It's too bad! I've found that person, but was suddenly attacked by Thunder Hawkman.
$i$I didn't see the one you mentioned. But when I was about to go out of Holy War Wilderness, I felt some binding power.
$i$I've collected all of them. I always feel that someone is watching me. $n$You're right. Someone is there. Judging from these things you found, I'm sure it's the Necromancer.
$n$Ok, though I got some small trouble, I know how to get into Stormrage Temple.
$i$There is no clue at all. They won't be casted by the spell. We can't find the entrance in this way.
$n$Good job! Now we  have enough time to prepare.

$n$Of course, not all the Thunder Beasts are equally ignorant. Some have mastered the combat techniques involving the thunder element in their body over the past eons, such as the Thunder Knights. However, these beings are almost on the top of the chain of species. They will not be easy prey even for us.
$n$It's strange. Though the Stormrage Temple doesn't seem to have any entrance, the Sunset Warriors and Mages keep coming in and out. There must be an entrance somewhere.

$n$The Thunder Beasts roaming Rhinolicious Stoneland are known as rare creatures even for the entirety of Chroland. Their special build allows the thunder element to amass in their body. However, they are normally ignorant of how to release that.

$i$What's wrong with Wind Spirit? I feel that he is not really eliminated. $n$During the Holy War, Wind Spirit is the most powerful Spirit Guardian. He won't be killed so easily. He will definitely hide somewhere in Windy Plateau to restore his power and wait for another chance.
$n$The magic energy of Thunder Beast has disrupted the space around. I'm unable to sense anything now. We must resort to some special way.

$n$Something is not right. I sensed some strangers.
$n$I think you know, if you want to find Wind Spirit's hideout, you need to do it in a special way. It's my next destination as well. I could give you some hints if you can help me more.
$n$Why are you back again? Told you not to disturb me any more. $i$I just want to ask you about the position of Wind Spirit. I can do whatever you want.
$n$It seems my guess is correct. It is a fascinating finding indeed. Besides, the sphere hovering in this area seems to be slowly expanding outward.
$n$You're with that guy? Well, I knew you've been following me. But I don’t need Bone Fragments anymore.
$n$I can sense the Smell of Death thick in the air. Such excitement! I haven't been touched by this feeling for too long.

$n$If I recall correctly, numerous bodies and bones used to stack here. It seems they have all be raised to become Skeleton Mage. If this is true, the magical sphere here somehow resembles our necromancy.
$n$I think I've found him. He seems to be injured.
$n$No need to worry about running out of magic or dealing with intruders. The Smell of Death is thick in the air. This is really the paradise for the study of necromancy.
$n$It's good to have someone help. I'm considering to enslave someone as my servant.
$n$You've done a great job. What a shame you don't practice some witchcraft like me.

$i$How can it be, so many Thunder Hawkmen in the Holy War Wilderness? The magical power here doesn't do any harm to them? $n$You may have heard about the magical fray in the Holy War Wilderness. The explosion formed a relentless magical sphere as we see now, as well as many mutant creatures. The Thunder Hawkman is one of them. Of course, their use of magics comes by nature. I still remember it is claimed that they are native to an alien world, only to be drawn here by the pull of magic. So funny!
$n$Are you concerned with what I'm going to do with this power I will soon acquire? Ah ha, I don't even have time to bother about that.
$i$He is a wanderer. Looks like he can find Wind Spirit. Now that you've seen his shadow, you must believe Wind Spirit has turned evil. How to prove that to the wanderer?

$n$Apart from my prejudice against the Great Rift, it is a fantastic place indeed. The Great Rift above the Holy War Wilderness was created by fierce magical strife long ago. It appears to be a portal to another magical plane, thus a window to a brand new landscape of magic. Many mages obsessed themselves with the study of space magics.
$n$How is it? What did you find? The hell knows who created such a hilarious explanation. There are even idiots who believe it. Are you also transported from another plane? Ha ha!
$n$Young man, you're quite strong. Wouldn't it be interesting to turn you into one of  my puppets as well?

$n$That's who they are! Don't take it personal. A real warrior wouldn't care about the words of others.
$n$Dauntless Mercenary Group has only existed for two years, which is quite young for many traditional ones.

$n$Now you know this as well. We encountered the magic mutation at Windy Plateau as well. It's not a good thing.
$n$Our group is full now. You need to show me what you can do if you want to join us.
$n$Sacred Boundary is not only abundant in resources, but also a place for rumors. Most of them are about treasure, though very few of them are true.
$n$In such a place, various Mercenary Groups often fight for the resources. This is unavoidable. They all have to survive after all.

$n$Sacred Boundary is located at the intersection of Windy Plateau, Dragon Mountain and Stony Gobi. It attracted many adventurers, mages and mercenaries. The trade here is more prosperous than in the Chroland Capital.

$n$This news travels very fast. Our Mercenary Group never let such a good opportunity slip away.
$n$I just knew Samuel would get impatient. We've been watching you, and we've captured Samuel. You can't run away either.

$n$What Samuel said is reasonable. But no one would be able to resist the temptation of that enormous treasure. Well, I need to confirm the rumor again.
$n$The first reason why our Mercenary Group become the top one in such a chaotic world is discipline. It might seem funny to you now, but you will understand in the future.
$i$Balic said you were captured by the Dauntless Mercenary Group. How come...$n$I have my own way. It's a pity that the treasures…
$n$You can't hide it from me. We finally found it. Looks we were right. The treasure must be somewhere near the Big Rift in Holy War Wilderness.

$n$My goodness! You're back! You found some treasure? It can't be. The Dauntless Mercenary Group found nothing before they made it to Holy War Wilderness. $i$Nothing special there. We found the Skeleton Warrior were very furious. I smelled some strange flower fragrance there.
$n$I can't remember the name of that marketplace, but it was really prosperous once. It wouldn't be difficult for them to transfer their wealth.
$i$Elder did not say anything. Seems there must be something very horrible.
$n$What's this? Fragment of a holy grail? I've never seen anything like this.
$n$They found out about it too? They are the largest local Mercenary Group. Be careful doing this in front of their eyes.
$n$The book about phoenix? Where did I put it? It is an aged book. Phoenix is the creature in the legends. You will become the strongest fighter if you can get its recognition.

$i$Do you have any other books or things relating to the Phoenix? $n$Record about the Phoenix is always scarce. A small book in my hand is quite something here. Still looking for the Phoenix after so long time? You better save it. I have some news here. I wonder if you'd like to cooperate.
$n$Looks like they were summoned by some mysterious power. In Holy War Wilderness, many wars happened there. Legend has it that Odis, the god of war, died there.
$n$I've found what you talked about. It's been long ago.
$n$Phoenix is the eldest creature of Chroland with immortality and great flexibility. They live in the deepest Dragon Mountain. You will get the power to tame them if you could get their recognition.
$n$I knew you wouldn't let such a good opportunity slip away.
$i$The strange smell came from some Bone Fragments. They are giving off some red radiance. I have no idea where they came from.

$n$Their skills and ways of attack both resembled those of the Whisperwind Warriors as I remember. If that is true, it must be quite an excitement for the warriors in pursuit of strength.

$n$Wind Spirit is saved. But you seem to have forgot something.
$n$I can feel that the call of Wind Spirit becomes even stronger. It seems we'll find Wind Spirit very soon.
